My two friends, one who identifies as bisexual and the other who identifies as lesbian, were talking about how they view their sexual orientation. The bisexual one mentioned feeling very comfortable and set in their sexual orientation, while the lesbian one has always felt that their sexuality is fluid and just plans to go with what feels right in the future. Who will probably change their sexual orientation later in life?
A. The bisexual one
B. Not enough information
C. The lesbian one
